objective: Contradict the J17/J18 exact checker and complex row-bound implementation using malformed CSR storage, a hand-coded high-precision Decimal oracle, exact rowwise roundoff comparisons, and simulated checkpoint replacement failure.

oracles_and_cases.decimal_oracle: Decimal.from_float inputs, independently accumulated complex products and squared norms at 2600-digit precision; compare squared residual directly with threshold_squared times the exact reference_squared.
oracles_and_cases.malformed_csr: Floating and complex index arrays, floating indptr, and an unsigned pointer exceeding stored entries must return INCONCLUSIVE without exception.
oracles_and_cases.complex_bound_probe: Seed 190719; 32 CSR rows with 1-8 stored terms, unsorted/duplicate columns, exponent choices -600,-500,-53,0,450,500; compare exact binary rational error of CSR product plus subtraction against each computed row bound.
oracles_and_cases.checkpoint_fault: Force os.replace to raise after a previous complete checkpoint exists; previous JSON must remain parseable and unchanged.

criteria.pass: Each nodeid completes with the contracted independent-oracle decision. The row-bound probe has zero violations for this finite sample. Atomic-write fault injection preserves the last complete checkpoint.
criteria.fail: Any malformed CSR input is certified instead of INCONCLUSIVE, oracle disagreement, row-bound violation, or prior checkpoint corruption.
criteria.interpretation: Passing these synthetic tests is bounded evidence only; it does not prove a universal production bound or mechanical accuracy.

historical_policy: J14-J18 verdicts, thresholds, and archives are not modified.
